title: Why Boring Tasks Feel Impossible With ADHD #Shorts

voiceover: Someone you love goes quiet for a day and your brain decides they hate you now. It is a working memory gap -- your brain cannot hold emotional information when the source is not in front of you. Common in ADHD. Follow for daily ADHD content.

description: Executive dysfunction is not laziness — it is a dopamine gap in the prefrontal cortex that breaks the bridge between knowing and doing. This short explains the real neuroscience behind why simple tasks feel impossible for ADHD brains, and gives a concrete first step that actually works with your wiring.
